title: A Symbol Whose Cube Vanishes
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · three rational slots and a falling fourth, a two-term inverse checked grade by grade, a chain-rule example, a flat tangent step against an arc step on a circle, the fidelity curve with its osculating jet, a secant chord against the tangent, five sampling weights around the unit circle, two equal half-steps
summary: Calculus without a limit: one formal symbol η with η³ = 0 turns every quantity into three rational slots (value, slope, half the bend), and the truncated product drops everything past the third slot (computed). Division stops after two terms: the closed-form inverse of a jet with nonzero finite first slot, checked grade by grade on a = (2, 2, 1), and the first- and second-order chain rules at zero inner shift, shown on g = (1, 2, 3), f = (0, 1/2, 1/4) (Lean: mul_inv, chain_rule; the examples are computed). On a circle drawn to scale, a flat tangent step pokes out while the arc step x₀(1 + ηv − ½η²‖v‖²) has squared norm 1 modulo η³ (the chapter's hand derivation); at a real step 1/2 the squared lengths are 5/4 and 65/64 (computed); reading the three grades as past, present and future is the book's model (argued). The fidelity kernel κ(x) = 1/(1 + x²) gets its exact jet, with the triple (1/2, −1/2, 1/4) at x = 1 (Lean: kappa_jet_one) and the chapter's four anchors (computed); the secant's exact error h(3x² + 2xh − 1)/((1 + x²)²(1 + (x + h)²)) (Lean: kappa_secant_discrepancy) gives −18/41 and +5/82 at (1, 1/4) and an accidental zero at (1/2, 1/4), where the chord still misses the bend −16/125 (computed). Finally, a finite step on the three-sphere sampled at weight α drifts by (1 − 2α)‖x − x₀‖² (Lean: alpha_sampling_norm_drift): the chapter's five weights give 23/9, 135/79, 1, 79/135, 9/23 (recomputed by exact quaternion algebra), the midpoint stays on the sphere (Lean: midpoint_unit_norm), lands on (11, 18, 12, 6)/25, and its two half-steps share fidelity 121/625 (Lean: midpoint_half_step_fidelity). Itô and Stratonovich appear as the chapter's literature remark (argued).
summary_zh: 不取极限的微积分：一个形式符号 η，规定 η³ = 0，于是每个量都是三格有理数（值、斜率、弯曲的一半），截断乘法把第三格之后的一律丢掉（屏幕计算）。除法两项之内就终止：常数格有限且非零的射流有闭式逆，在 a = (2, 2, 1) 上逐阶乘回核对；零位移处的一阶与二阶链式法则在 g = (1, 2, 3)、f = (0, 1/2, 1/4) 上演示（Lean：mul_inv、chain_rule；例子为屏幕计算）。在按比例绘制的圆上，平直切向步刺出球壳，而圆弧步 x₀(1 + ηv − ½η²‖v‖²) 的模方模 η³ 恰为 1（本章手工推导）；取实际步长 1/2，两者模方分别为 5/4 与 65/64（屏幕计算）；把三阶读作过去、现在与未来是本书的模型诠释（论证）。保真度核 κ(x) = 1/(1 + x²) 得到精确射流，x = 1 处的三元组为 (1/2, −1/2, 1/4)（Lean：kappa_jet_one），本章四个锚点为屏幕计算；割线的精确偏差 h(3x² + 2xh − 1)/((1 + x²)²(1 + (x + h)²))（Lean：kappa_secant_discrepancy）在 (1, 1/4) 给出 −18/41 与 +5/82，在 (1/2, 1/4) 碰巧为零，而弦仍看不见弯曲项 −16/125（屏幕计算）。最后，三维球面上按权重 α 取样的有限步，模方漂移为 (1 − 2α)‖x − x₀‖²（Lean：alpha_sampling_norm_drift）：本章五档权重给出 23/9、135/79、1、79/135、9/23（以精确四元数运算复算），中点步留在球面上（Lean：midpoint_unit_norm），落在 (11, 18, 12, 6)/25，前后两个半拍的保真度同为 121/625（Lean：midpoint_half_step_fidelity）。伊藤与斯特拉托诺维奇作为本章的文献注记出现（论证）。
